name: Moonborn
source:
When Mia learns that vampires and werewolves exist, her ordinary life is turned upside down. 

Facing deadly foes and an ancient prophecy tied to her identity, she must fight for survival – and decide whether to accept her destiny or walk away.

[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Moonborn]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
当米娅得知吸血鬼和狼人的存在时，她平凡的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。

面对致命的敌人和与她的身份相关的古老预言，她必须为生存而战，并决定是接受命运还是走开。

[来自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Moonborn]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
